description: This file is a PHP script for displaying and processing test case search results within the TestLink project. It includes initialization of pages, handling search filters, querying the database for test cases based on various criteria, and rendering the results in a table format.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class that builds and manages a table UI component for displaying search results, allowing sorting and formatting.

methods.name: buildExtTable
methods.description: Constructs an HTML table to display test case search results retrieved from the database, with sorting and formatting options.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes input parameters from the user request for search criteria.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with default values and contextual information before rendering the search page.

methods.name: initSearch
methods.description: Populates the GUI with search filter options and values based on user input and project configuration.
